rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the northwest compass direction.

example.english: Our flat faces northwest, so it gets less sun in the afternoon.
example.traditional: 我哋間屋向西北，下午冇咁曬。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 hoeng3 sai1 bak1 haa6 ng5 mou5 gam3 saai3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose adjective for something situated toward or facing the northwest, such as a northwest-facing route or window.

example.english: The living room in this flat faces northwest, so it gets a bit colder in winter.
example.traditional: 呢間屋個客廳係西北向，冬天會凍啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 uk1 go3 haak3 teng1 hai6 sai1 bak1 hoeng3 dung1 tin1 wui5 dung3 di1
